full_name: Ella Hickson | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Arts Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow Independent Writer (United Kingdom)
bio: Ella Hickson is a British playwright known for investigating the cultural and political zeitgeist through formal experimentation and, in so doing, creating work that is both radical and entertaining. At Radcliffe, she will explore new research into the neurological changes that occur in mothers before and after birth and seek to find an artistic form that expresses how these changes alter the subject’s conception of time.
